reasoning: `if (status === 404)` becomes `if (404 === status)`. The test pins `expect(wrap(errorForWrap(404))).toBeInstanceOf(NotFound)`, where the test-local `wrap` returns its argument, and `expect(errorForWrap(403)).toBeInstanceOf(Forbidden)`; all three listed mutants fail the test. RIPR-SPEC-0249 example 5, amended 2026-10-15: a pin on `wrap(errorFor(404))` is credited when `wrap` is a top-level, unexported one-parameter function whose body is exactly `return err;` and whose name the file uses only as a direct call. `wrap` qualifies here, so the 404 pin reads `exact_value` / strong at the changed boundary and ripr reports `exposed`, matching the discriminated truth.
